verdict_reason: Correct thin fragment wrapping the shared results partial in appMultiSelectSearchResults, but it duplicates the page template's hand-built params block for that partial, giving the results mapping two homes.

todos.issue: The commoditySearchResults params block (copy, commodityGroups, noResults, carriedKeys, selectedSummary) at search-results.njk:5-11 is a verbatim copy of search.njk:36-42. Both are fed by the same resultsContext() in search.controller.js, so a param added to _results.njk and to resultsContext must be threaded through two templates; missing one breaks only the JS path or only the no-JS path, and the controller tests (which assert view context only, never rendered HTML) would not catch it.
todos.fix: Must: the mapping from the controller's results context to the _results.njk partial has one home, shared by the full page and the results fragment. One way: have search.controller.js nest resultsContext under one key (e.g. results: resultsContext(current, shown)) in both render and renderResults, and have both templates call commoditySearchResults(results) — or have _results.njk read the context variables directly and be included rather than called with a hand-built params object.
